latestReleaseNotes:
### Release info
Oobee is available as a desktop app for Mac and Windows. The setup files can be downloaded under `Assets` at the bottom of the page.

### Installation Guide
* Refer to the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/blob/master/INSTALLATION.md) for Windows and Mac.

### What's New
This release ensures pages can no longer silently vanish from a scan: pages that hit a transient failure are now retried, and pages that are skipped (robots.txt-blocked, off-site redirects, unsupported content) are listed as unscanned in the JSON, CSV and report. It keeps scan results consistent when the host is under heavy CPU or memory load (pages are fully hydrated before axe runs, concurrency only drops on 403/429, real CPU starvation or memory pressure, and renderer crashes are retried). It fixes sitemap discovery for non-standard sitemaps, adds a family-DNS failover path, lets the report page title and URL be customised via env vars, and makes the desktop app trust the operating system's certificate store, which fixes connections on networks that use a corporate/custom root CA. It also includes several rounds of security hardening.

#### Improvements
* feat(page-capture): record element geometry and pseudo-element styles by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/868
* feat: fail over family DNS across three providers (FAMILY_DNS) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/867
* Provide OOBEE_REPORT_PAGE_TITLE and OOBEE_REPORT_PAGE_URL as ENV value to customize title and url by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/898
* feat: split client bundle Sentry DSN from Node-side DSN by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/860
* Updating Inspect preset integrations by @Sachin-Gamage in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/862
* Add log() needed for dismissing custom flow overlay scan interface by @WilsonkwSheng in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/874
* ci: add parallel PR test workflow (unit + e2e) by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/900

#### Fixes
* fix: report every dropped page as unscanned instead of losing it by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/903
* fix: quiet GenAI feature flag fetch failure in report and add timeout by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/902
* fix: non-standard sitemap fallback regex was line-anchored, missing embedded URLs by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/901
* fix: stabilise axe results under CPU contention and stop multi-hour 403/429 stalls by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/879
* fix(mac): don't abort installer on xattr quarantine-removal errors by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/882
* fix(report): escape U+2028/U+2029 in itemsStore JSONL by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/881
* fix(report): show custom-flow page screenshots in About modal by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/880
* fix(report): resolve SAFE_HREF_SCHEMES redeclaration blanking page counts by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/871
* fix(url-check): report server HTTP status instead of generic system error by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/872
* Replace broken jest suites with node:test by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee/pull/885
* fix(tls): trust the OS certificate store in the main process by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/305
* fix: scope userData write allowlist to renderer-supplied payloads by @younglim in https://github.com/GovTechSG/oobee-desktop/pull/294
